units.source_text: 起先人们到处高声谈论：火灾是因为电影胶片着火引起的啦，

en.t: At first, people everywhere were talking loudly: the fire was caused by the movie film catching fire,

units.source_text: 把看电影的小孩一个个从二楼扔下来啦，没人受伤啦，

en.t: the children who had been watching the film were thrown one by one from the second floor, and no one was hurt,

units.source_text: 幸亏现在没把村里的蚕蛹和大米放进去啦，如此等等。

en.t: and luckily the village's silkworm cocoons and rice had not been stored inside now, and so on.

units.source_text: 然而，如今大家面对大火，却默然无言。

en.t: Yet now, facing the great fire, everyone was silently without words.

units.source_text: 失火现场无论远近，都统一在一片寂静的气氛之中。

en.t: Near and far, the scene of the fire was held together in an atmosphere of complete stillness.

units.source_text: 只听见燃烧声和水泵声。

en.t: Only the sound of burning and the sound of the pump could be heard.
